name: gizza-ai/image-metadata-viewer
summary: Read EXIF/GPS metadata from an image

tool.description: Read and display EXIF/TIFF metadata embedded in an image — camera make/model, exposure/aperture/ISO, lens, orientation, timestamps, and GPS. Returns every metadata field (tag, value, IFD) plus the GPS location decoded to decimal latitude/longitude when present. Works on JPEG/TIFF/HEIF/PNG/WebP that carry EXIF. Provide the image as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call).

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.
